description:
Cast Ardent Electromancer by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Electromancer enters, it triggers, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor by paying {0}, targeting Ardent Electromancer.
Cowardice triggers, returning Ardent Electromancer from the battlefield to your hand.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no valid target.
